summary: On paper this one is close: Green Bay's best edge is to win short yardage (Green Bay's defense ranks 1st in short-yardage run success, 32% allowed). The model favors Green Bay at 55%, mostly on home field (1.7 pts) and passing matchup (1.2 pts).

ATL.detail: Atlanta ranks 5th in short-yardage run success (49%). Green Bay's defense ranks 1st (32% allowed).
Atlanta ranks 27th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.07). Green Bay's defense ranks 2nd (+0.05 allowed).

GB.detail: Green Bay's defense ranks 1st in short-yardage run success (32% allowed). Atlanta ranks 5th (49%).
Green Bay's defense ranks 2nd in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.05 allowed). Atlanta ranks 27th (+0.07).

team_cards.t1: Green Bay has the NFL's best short-yardage defense.
team_cards.t2: Atlanta has the 5th-best short-yardage run game.
team_cards.note: Short yardage = 2nd & 1-6 and 3rd & 1-3 · GB: n=16 short-yardage runs

model.summary: Model: Green Bay 55% to win, fair line GB -1.5. Market: Green Bay 67%. The largest factor is home field, worth 1.7 points toward Green Bay.

model_cards.t1: The model likes Atlanta more than the market.
model_cards.sub: Win probability. Market = vig-free moneyline at build time.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Not betting advice · market line at build time

model_cards.sub: Each factor's push on the projected margin, in points. Positive = toward Green Bay. Sum = GB -1.5.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Linear model, so contributions are exact SHAP values · vs. an average matchup

model_cards.sub: Distribution of Green Bay's margin. Shaded area = Green Bay win (55%).
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Normal margin, sigma = 12.0 points (fit by log loss)

model_cards.t1: Green Bay is missing 1.3 starters' worth of snaps.
model_cards.t2: Injuries move the line 0.6 points toward Atlanta.
model_cards.sub: Players listed Out, Doubtful or Questionable, weighted by recent snap share. QBs are in the QB factor.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Weight = snap share (last 4 games) x status (Out 1.0, Doubtful 0.85, Questionable 0.25)

model_cards.t1: The biggest unit gap: Green Bay's pass offense.
model_cards.t2: 0.08 EPA per play better than Atlanta's.
model_cards.sub: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play vs. league average, the inputs to the model. Right = better.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Recency-weighted, last season's plays at 35% weight

model_cards.t2: It trails the market: Brier 0.226 vs. 0.211.
model_cards.sub: Walk-forward backtest, 2018-2025 (2087 games). Each season uses only earlier data.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Brier score: lower is better · market = closing line
